subject: Bruno Guimaraes returns to St James' Park with Arsenal, who paid a reported £75m
title: Guimaraes returns to St James' Park

lines.vo: For a reported seventy-five million pounds, Guimaraes returns to St James' Park.
lines.footage: Guimaraes Newcastle clips, St James' Park wide shot

lines.vo: Saturday, five-thirty UK time: Arsenal at Newcastle. Old club, new colours.
He scored nine league goals last season, and thirty-one in total for Newcastle.
He started slowly at Arsenal. Now he is first choice, with goals against Sunderland and Leeds.
lines.footage: Arsenal midfield match clips, goal clips vs Sunderland and vs Leeds

lines.vo: Arteta says he is still not there. Praise from Arteta clearly comes in instalments.
Arsenal are five points clear. Harvey Barnes says this is the match Newcastle need.
lines.footage: league table graphic, Newcastle training b-roll

lines.vo: Got a view on this one? News, betting tips and predictions at aboutfootball dot UK.

inserts.story: A caricature of Guimaraes knocks on the door of his old stadium wearing a new shirt. Gag: the door opens and a doorman squints at the shirt. Twist: the doorman waves him in and hands him a cup of tea.
A cartoon coach feeds a coin into a praise vending machine. Gag: one tiny compliment drops out at a time. Twist: the machine says Come back tomorrow.
inserts.characters: generic cartoon coach and vending machine

facts_used: Arsenal paid a reported 75 million pounds; he faces Newcastle on Saturday 21 November at 5:30pm UK time (news 170)
